findings.comment: Adjoining land uses not labeled on site plan or location map. Adjacent properties include SF-3, GO, MF-3, MF-3-CO, and MF-2-CO zoning per project records, but these zoning designations and use classifications are not shown on the plan sheets. The location map shows adjacent property boundaries and structures but provides no labels identifying the use class of each adjacent property.

No dedicated Paving Plan sheet submitted with site plan. Sheet 22 (Construction Details 1) contains standard construction details for curbs, sidewalks, and driveways but is not a paving plan. A comprehensive paving plan showing the overall layout and extent of all proposed paving areas with dimensions, slopes, and material specifications is required.

Sheet 29 is labeled 'Addressing Plan' showing proposed unit numbers within buildings but is not a formally approved addressed layout document. An Approved Addressed Layout signed or stamped by the City of Austin Development Services Department must be attached to the plan set as documentation that the proposed addresses have been approved by the city.

Legend is not shown on the site plan sheet itself (Sheet 9). While Sheet 3 (General Notes) contains a comprehensive legend defining symbols for utilities, easements, and other features, this legend is not present on the primary site plan sheet where these symbols are used. A legend explaining line weights, symbols, and visual distinctions between existing and proposed elements should appear on Sheet 9.

applicableAreas: Project location map and vicinity area
findings.comment: Vicinity plan (location map on cover sheet) does not outline the class of every building/structure in the vicinity. The map shows adjacent property boundaries and structures but does not label zoning classifications (SF-3, GO, MF-3, etc.) or land use designations for adjacent buildings, making it impossible to understand the surrounding development context from the plan alone.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet and plan set documentation
findings.comment: Figure 2.5.1 (site development regulations showing setbacks, building coverage, impervious cover allowances, and other zoning requirements) is not provided with the site plan. This figure, which displays the applicable development standards for the MF-2 zoning, must be included as a legible copy attached to the plan set for verification of compliance.

Base, redeveloped, and new impervious cover are not shown with distinct shading and clear labeling. Sheet 13 (Drainage Area Map) shows existing and proposed drainage areas on separate maps and labels them with 'Ex' and 'Pro' prefixes, but impervious cover areas within each map are not visually distinguished with distinct hatch patterns or shading. Numerical values appear only in tables; visual differentiation of base, redeveloped, and new impervious cover on the plan graphics themselves is absent.

Existing Conditions Sheet (Sheet 4) does not clearly identify and label which improvements from prior site plans will remain and which will be demolished. The prior site plan (SP-97-0145CS) included a nursing care facility demolished in June 2022; however, Sheet 4 does not explicitly label 'To Remain' or 'Will be Demolished' for any improvements from prior site plans. This information must be clearly documented on the Existing Conditions Sheet or Demolition Plan with explicit labeling.

Overlay of the current proposed site plan not included on the demolition plan sheet. Sheet 8 shows existing site conditions with demolition callouts but does not include an overlay of the proposed site plan layout (proposed buildings, parking, utilities) to provide spatial context showing how demolition areas relate to future development. The demolition plan should be overlaid with proposed site plan elements to clarify the relationship between removal and new construction.
